title: REMEMORY RECOVERY BUNDLE
what_bundle_for: Someone who trusts you made this bundle, so that important files of theirs can still be opened if one day they can't do it themselves. This set of bundles is called "{0}".
what_one_of: You are one of {0} friends who each hold a piece of the key to those files.
what_threshold: The files open only when {0} pieces are brought together. No one can open them alone.
warning_message_friends: Keep this bundle somewhere safe, and a printed copy too if you can — paper lasts. There's nothing else to do for now. If the time ever comes, the friends listed below hold the other pieces.
warning_message_shares: Keep this bundle somewhere safe, and a printed copy too if you can — paper lasts. There's nothing else to do for now. If the time ever comes, you'll bring your piece together with the others.
other_holders: THE FRIENDS WHO HOLD THE OTHER PIECES
sharing_title: IF SOMEONE ASKS YOU FOR YOUR PIECE
sharing_verify: First, make sure the request is real. If you can, check with the person who made this bundle. If you can't reach them, check with another friend who holds a piece.
sharing_easiest: The simplest way to help is to send them this whole bundle — the ZIP file.
sharing_readme_only: If that's not possible, this README file is enough on its own.
sharing_words_phone: If you can't send a file, read them the recovery words below over the phone.
sharing_qr_mail: You can also mail them a printed copy. The QR code on it holds your piece.
recovery_words_hint:
Read these words to the person bringing the pieces together, or type them
into recover.html yourself.
recovery_words_dual_hint: Either list works. Both hold the same piece.
machine_readable: THE SAME PIECE AS TEXT (to paste into recover.html):
qr_caption: Scan with a phone camera to add this piece
recover_browser: IF YOU'RE THE ONE BRINGING THE PIECES TOGETHER
recover_step_open: Open recover.html from this bundle. It opens in your web browser, like a web page.
recover_share_loaded: Your piece is already in it.
recover_no_html: If you can't find it, any friend can send you theirs. There's also a copy at {0}
recover_step_locked_files: Add the locked files: drag MANIFEST.age, from this same bundle, onto the page.
recover_step_contact: Tell the friends listed above what has happened, and ask them for their piece.
recover_step_add: Add each piece as it arrives:
recover_step_add_file: - drag their bundle or their README file onto the page,
recover_step_add_paste: - or paste their text, or type the words they read to you,
recover_step_add_scan: - or scan the QR code on their printed copy.
recover_step_checkmarks: A checkmark appears next to each name as its piece comes in.
recover_step_auto: Once you have {0} pieces, the files unlock on their own.
recover_step_download: Download the files and keep them somewhere private.
recover_offline: None of this needs an internet connection.
recover_offline_tlock: These files have a time lock: opening them needs a brief internet connection, and they won't open before their date.
recover_cli_hint: Someone comfortable with computers can use the ReMemory program instead. It can be downloaded from:
recover_cli_usage: With the bundles in one folder: rememory recover first-bundle.zip second-bundle.zip
metadata_note: The lines below are for the recovery tools. You can ignore them.
